metaTitle: Custom New Era Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom New Era bags in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate giveaways.
introHtml: New Era bags bring the iconic sports and streetwear style your recipients already trust. Whether you're outfitting a corporate team or creating event swag, these bags carry the same quality as the brand's famous caps. The New Era Game Day Cinch, for example, offers a lightweight, packable design perfect for gym giveaways or conference totes. Add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a polished, pro look that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom New Era bags with embroidered logo, including a black Game Day Cinch backpack on a white background.
